description: This file is a source code module implementing a debugging helper function for listing contents of a Supabase Storage bucket. It contains a single exported function 'debugListBucket' that logs bucket contents or errors to the console for debugging purposes.

methods.name: debugListBucket(bucket, prefix = undefined)
methods.description: An asynchronous function that lists files in a specified Supabase Storage bucket, optionally under a given prefix, and logs the results or errors to the console.
